# Miss Pembroke

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Miss Pembroke has keen dark eyes and a wrinkled cheek.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)_

## Personality

Miss Pembroke is an elderly lady who is known to be somewhat self-centered. Despite this trait, she proves to be exceptionally welcoming and provides her guests with splendid entertainment.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P26](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)_

## Traits

- somewhat self-centered  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)</sub>
- welcoming  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P26](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0026)</sub>

## History

Miss Pembroke was a self-centered old lady who rarely held affection for anyone other than herself and never engaged in mischievous antics during her youth. While [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her classmates adjusted to life at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) as exams approached, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) continued to pay her visits at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P85](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0085), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## Relationships

### [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harcourt--miss-pembroke.md)

Miss Pembroke counts [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) as a friend who is a frequent visitor and favorite companion at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood). Their bond is established through these regular visits and shared time together.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/miss-pembroke--nell-harcourt.md)

Miss Pembroke shares a strong friendship with [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md). While adjusting to her studies and upcoming examinations at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) frequently makes time to visit Miss Pembroke at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood).
